summary: Quanta Services, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its 2026 Annual Meeting results and announcing a new stock repurchase program authorized by the Board as of May 21, 2026. The filing discloses director elections and advisory votes but does not specify the size, terms, or duration of the buyback authorization. This capital return mechanism signals a commitment to return value to shareholders, though lacking detail. Watch for a subsequent 8-K with program parameters to assess scale and execution pace.
